title: elatostema stenocarpum
intro: Elatostema stenocarpum, commonly known as the Asian waterclover, is a type of flowering plant in the nettle family (Urticaceae). It has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues due to its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Elatostema stenocarpum include reducing swelling, fighting infections, and soothing digestive issues. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
